left.title: Selam Leki
left.description: This mezmur is a hymn of veneration to the Virgin Mary, greeting her with titles drawn from the Old Testament and sacred tradition. She is symbolically identified with holy objects and events such as Noah’s Ark, Aaron’s rod, Gideon’s fleece, Jacob’s ladder, and the manna of heaven—each pointing to her role in bearing Christ. The chant emphasizes her purity, divine selection, and her place as the Mother of God (Eme Egziabher). Through poetic praise, the faithful honor her as the fulfillment of biblical types and approach her with reverence, asking for her blessings and intercession.

አማላጄ አንቺን ይዥለሁ
አዛኝቱ አንቺን ይዥለሁ

ለእግዚአብሔር ቃል ማደሪያ ሆናለች

ከልጅነት አንደበቴ

ከኮልታፋው አንደበቴ
